fact: Decree 2018-062/PR of 21 March 2018 is made in application of Law 2017-007 of 22 June 2017 on electronic transactions, which the decree cites as the law governing electronic contracts, written records, electronic signatures and online selling in Togo.
system: Loi n° 2017-007 du 22 juin 2017 relative aux transactions électroniques

fact: Decree 2018-062/PR, adopted by the Council of Ministers on 21 March 2018 (105 articles), regulates electronic transactions and services under Law 2017-007: formalities for e-commerce sellers (Art. 6), electronic signatures and qualified certificates, trust service providers and the accreditation procedure.
system: Décret n° 2018-062/PR portant réglementation des transactions et services électroniques

fact: Law 2023-012 of 19 July 2023, promulgated and published in Journal officiel no. 55 bis, amends Law 2017-007 of 22 June 2017 on electronic transactions, redefining its terms and adding rules on electronic seals, digital safes, 20-year retention of electronic copies and signatures, and a penalty for usurping the status of trust service provider.
